description: April 20 birthday meaning: Aries or Taurus cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, April 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aries or Taurus. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: April 20 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Taurus season usually begins on April 20, with the Sun entering the first degree of Venus's fixed earth sign. In some years, or for births early in the day, the Sun may still be in Aries. Number 2 leans towards harmony, giving this threshold birthday a gentle, sensual and loyal character with a spark of fire.

On April 20 the Sun usually sits at about 0° Taurus, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. Born around April 19 or 20, you sit near the line between Aries and Taurus, fire giving way to earth. Which sign your Sun actually occupies depends on the birth year, the time of day and the location, because the ingress moment moves slightly from year to year; a natal chart calculated for your details is the only way to be sure. Traditionally, people on this cusp are said to combine Aries' initiative with Taurus' staying power. That can read as determined and practical, or as stubborn twice over, depending on the day.

sections.heading: April 20 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 20 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on April 20: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 20 is the 110th day of the year (111st in a leap year). By May 21, 31 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 20 include Napoleon III (1808), Joan Miró (1893) and Gro Harlem Brundtland (1939).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 20?
faq.answer: April 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aries or Taurus on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Taurus. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 20 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 20?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 20?
faq.answer: April 20 is also the birthday of Napoleon III (1808), Joan Miró (1893) and Gro Harlem Brundtland (1939). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
